key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9862
name: branch_sign_then_call_sets
description: Tests whether a signed input is negative and runs one of two unnamed call sequences (five calls or seven calls). It then runs a shared block that ORs a mask into a set of structure words when a counter is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:999E
name: load_position_fields_from_record
description: Copies two longwords and one word from a record at fixed offsets, or otherwise derives shifted coordinate values from another input, then makes six unnamed calls. It finishes with the shared counter-gated OR block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:99F0
name: scale_inputs_then_call_routines
description: When an input is non-negative, shifts two words left by five bits into working globals and shifts another value right by four. It then makes six unnamed calls and runs the shared counter-gated OR block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9B3E
name: relay_four_calls_then_mask
description: Does nothing beyond making four unnamed calls and then running the shared counter-gated OR block. It is a thin wrapper with no logic of its own.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9B6E
name: stub_four_call_relay
description: Makes four unnamed calls in sequence and then runs the shared counter-gated OR block. It has no logic of its own and only passes control onward.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9B72
name: stub_four_call_relay_entry
description: Makes four unnamed calls in sequence and then runs the shared counter-gated OR block. It is a wrapper with no logic of its own, referenced by a pointer in data.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9B76
name: stub_four_call_relay_variant
description: Makes four unnamed calls and then runs the shared counter-gated OR block. It has no logic of its own and is a separate entry into the same chain.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9BB2
name: program_blitter_registers
description: Waits until the blitter busy flag clears, then loads the blitter modulo, first and last word mask, source and destination pointer and size registers from a structure. It then runs the shared counter-gated OR block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9C60
name: stub_four_call_relay_late
description: Makes four unnamed calls in sequence and then runs the shared counter-gated OR block. It is a wrapper with no logic of its own.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9C9C
name: branch_flag_call_sets_then_mask
description: Chooses between two five-call sequences depending on whether a flag byte is zero, then runs the shared counter-gated OR block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9D52
name: relay_five_calls_then_mask
description: Makes five unnamed calls and then runs the shared counter-gated OR block. It is a thin wrapper with no logic of its own.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9D9C
name: run_countdown_state_machine
description: Counts down a timer word, and when it reaches zero resets several status words. It otherwise reloads the timer from a routine result scaled by a constant, and it references the game title text.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9DF2
name: select_record_copy_string
description: Looks up a fixed-size record by index. If a word in the record is zero it clears the pointer and flag, otherwise it copies a zero-terminated string from the record into a routine buffer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9E3A
name: find_flagged_record_copy_text
description: Scans up to ten fixed-size records for one whose flag byte has value two set, then copies its zero-terminated string into a routine buffer. If none matches it clears the pointer and sets the flag to minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9E42
name: copy_flagged_record_patrol_text
description: Loops over fixed-size records checking a flag bit and copies a zero-terminated string from the first matching record. The copied text references the ' on patrol' label.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9EB4
name: set_bitplane_position_dma
description: Divides a scaled coordinate by forty-five to get a column and row, picks an offset from the remainder, and writes the result into the bitplane position pointers. It also enables DMA channels by writing with the set bit in the DMA control register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:9F5A
name: service_pending_flag_calls
description: When a pending word is set, it clears it, resets a counter word and makes several unnamed calls. Otherwise it skips straight to the shared counter-gated OR block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A04E
name: refresh_countdown_and_calls
description: Makes four unnamed calls and sets a pending word. When a countdown value is nonzero it makes three more calls, then runs the shared counter-gated OR block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A100
name: service_countdown_extended_calls
description: Makes four unnamed calls and sets a pending word. When a countdown is nonzero it makes eleven unnamed calls before the shared counter-gated OR block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A1E0
name: copy_saved_state_compare
description: Copies three saved words into working slots and makes two unnamed calls. When an index differs from a reference index it makes four more calls before the shared counter-gated OR block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A1E4
name: copy_saved_state_entry_variant
description: Copies three saved words into working slots, makes unnamed calls, and branches on an index compared with a reference value. It is a second entry into the same state-copy code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A2B6
name: update_sprite_pointers
description: When a flag is set, writes the pointer registers for all eight hardware sprites from computed addresses. The address offset advances in steps based on a column index.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A3A2
name: patch_slot_with_constant
description: Computes a slot offset by dividing a value by ten with a remainder check, saves the longword at that slot, writes a fixed constant into it, and makes two unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A46C
name: clear_two_pointer_cells
description: Writes zero into two longwords reached through pointers stored in a structure, then makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A47C
name: copy_two_fields_when_flagged
description: When a flag is nonzero, copies two longword fields from one structure into the matching fields of another structure.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A492
name: call_two_then_store_register
description: Makes two unnamed calls and then stores a processor register value into a global cell. It has no other logic.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A4CA
name: copy_sprite_fields_block_one
description: Copies six longword fields from a structure into working globals. The routine's register references include the sprite pointer registers of all eight sprites.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A50C
name: copy_sprite_fields_block_two
description: Copies five longword fields and one more field from a structure into working globals, then makes two unnamed calls. Its register references include the sprite pointer registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A54E
name: save_pointers_when_idle
description: When a countdown word is zero, copies a field from a structure and writes two saved values through pointers, using an offset from a divided index. It then makes two unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A55A
name: stub_sprite_field_copies
description: Repeats the same structure field copy seven times, the decompiler leaving only self-assignments. Its register references include the sprite pointer registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A58C
name: copy_sprite_fields_block_three
description: Copies four longword fields and one more field from a structure into working globals, referencing the sprite pointer registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A606
name: process_flagged_record_tables
description: Walks a table of fixed-size records and calls a routine for each record whose flag bit is set. It then walks a second table of seven entries, calling routines for nonzero entries, and references a short text token.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A870
name: tick_countdown_load_colours
description: Decrements a countdown and, while it is nonzero, calls a routine through a stored function pointer. When a pointer is set it copies colour values from a table into the colour registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A878
name: tick_countdown_colour_zero
description: Decrements the same countdown and calls a stored function pointer while it is nonzero. It then loads palette entries, including colour register zero, from a table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A912
name: stub_unreachable_single_call
description: Only a single unnamed call survives decompilation, the rest being marked as unreachable code. The routine is effectively a stub.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:A94A
name: check_range_then_dispatch
description: Clears a status word and tests a chain of range conditions on position-like values. When all of them hold, it makes nine unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:AB20
name: initialise_display_state_globals
description: Clears a block of working globals and sets several to fixed constants. A flagged branch sets further values, and two unnamed calls follow.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:AC72
name: update_status_text_flight_controls
description: Converts two inputs into offsets by shifting and subtracting, then derives coordinate deltas from them. It makes seventeen unnamed calls and references status text such as 'brakes on' and 'landing gear raised'.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:BDCE
name: update_state_on_pointer_match
description: Compares a stored pointer with two candidate addresses inside a structure. When one matches it reads a two-bit field, updates a stored state value and sets a word to a constant, then makes three unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:BEBE
name: track_wrapped_value_delta
description: Stores previous values, takes a new value from a routine and computes its signed difference, wrapping at half of a 16-bit range. It then stores a scaled copy of the result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:BEC2
name: track_wrapped_delta_extended
description: Performs the same wrapped difference tracking as its neighbouring routine. It is extended with further calls and a bit-mask merge with the value 255.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C1B0
name: interpolate_table_pair_entry
description: Linearly interpolates two values between neighbouring entries of a table pair, using the low five bits of a stored index as the fraction. The result is shifted back down by five bits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C1B8
name: interpolate_table_pair_entry
description: Linearly interpolates two values between neighbouring entries of a table pair, using the low five bits of a stored index as the fraction. This is a single-instruction entry point into the same interpolation code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C1CC
name: interpolate_table_pair_entry
description: Linearly interpolates two values between neighbouring table entries using a fraction from the low five bits of a stored index. This is an entry point into the same interpolation code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C1E0
name: interpolate_table_pair_entry
description: Linearly interpolates two values between neighbouring table entries using a fraction from the low five bits of a stored index. This is an entry point into the same interpolation code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C1E8
name: interpolate_table_pair_entry
description: Linearly interpolates two values between neighbouring table entries using a fraction from the low five bits of a stored index. This is an entry point into the same interpolation code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C1EC
name: interpolate_table_pair_entry
description: Linearly interpolates two values between neighbouring table entries using a fraction from the low five bits of a stored index. This is an entry point into the same interpolation code.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C1F0
name: interpolate_table_pair_masked
description: Interpolates pairs of table values with the same fractional weighting, merges a result with the value 255, and makes three unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C3CE
name: apply_two_by_two_transform
description: Multiplies pairs of coefficient values and sums them to form two transformed values, wrapping each into a 16-bit result. It makes four unnamed calls and merges a masked value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C512
name: apply_second_matrix_transform
description: Applies the same two-by-two coefficient transform to a different set of operands, wrapping each result into a 16-bit value. It makes four unnamed calls and merges a masked value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C656
name: apply_mixed_pair_transform
description: Combines two products of coefficient pairs, each shifted and checked for wrap-around, into a transformed pair. It merges the result with the value 255 and makes six unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C79A
name: divide_value_by_subtraction
description: Divides a value by repeated shift-and-subtract over seven steps, negating a negative input first. It is a division helper that makes no calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C7C4
name: normalise_signs_for_arithmetic
description: Handles the signs of a 16-bit operand pair before a multiply or divide, returning zero when the second operand is zero. It negates values as needed, with special handling for the most negative value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C820
name: subtract_result_from_constant
description: Calls one routine and returns the constant 16384 minus its result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C82C
name: lookup_table_index_by_value
description: Makes an input positive and searches a table of thresholds for the first entry above it. It then restores the sign and returns the index scaled by 32.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:C862
name: select_flight_limits_and_messages
description: Updates flight-state values from flag bits and a comparison, choosing limit constants from several options, and makes seven unnamed calls. It references status text such as 'ready for takeoff', 'safe landing' and 'weapons replenished'.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:D0CE
name: set_status_bits_and_position
description: Sets a status flag bit in a structure and makes six unnamed calls. It then computes a column and row from a scaled coordinate by dividing by forty-five, and enables DMA through the DMA control register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:D0F2
name: draw_weapon_status_hud
description: Toggles a flag and waits for the blitter before programming its registers. It makes seventeen unnamed calls and references HUD text such as 'missile lock', 'no target', 'primary' and 'secondary'.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:D82A
name: start_blitter_operation
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, then programs its control, mask, modulo, pointer and size registers. It finishes by making four unnamed calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:DA0E
name: toggle_phase_and_blit
description: Advances a phase value by half of a 16-bit range. When the phase had been in the lower half it waits for the blitter and programs its registers, and it sets a bit in a computed memory cell.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:DA2C
name: draw_phased_blit_sequence
description: Advances a phase value by half of a 16-bit range and programs the blitter when it wraps. It then makes sixteen unnamed calls and references a short text token.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:DEF2
name: unpack_rows_inside_window
description: Continues only when two coordinates fall inside a fixed rectangle. It then reads five-byte groups from a source pointer over six iterations and expands them into the destination, making one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:DFB0
name: compute_scaled_coordinate_difference
description: Returns the difference between two products of coordinate deltas, each scaled by a shift taken from a stored value, plus the constant 146. It makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:E00C
name: program_blitter_pass_through
description: Waits for the blitter, programs its registers with a fixed setup and returns its byte argument unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:E068
name: program_blit_destination_only
description: Waits for the blitter and programs its control, modulo, destination pointer and size registers. It makes one unnamed call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:E0A6
name: measure_larger_axis_distance
description: Computes a table offset from two coordinates, then the larger of the absolute horizontal and vertical differences. It branches on a comparison against a stored value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:E0AA
name: measure_larger_axis_distance
description: Computes a table offset from two coordinates, then the larger of the absolute horizontal and vertical differences. This is a variant entry point of the same measurement.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:E0AE
name: measure_larger_axis_distance
description: Computes a table offset from two coordinates, then the larger of the absolute horizontal and vertical differences. This is a variant entry point of the same measurement.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a].adf:game:0:E0B2
name: lookup_axis_distance_byte
